author: potuz
content:
Ok so we have three options:

1. We do not verify XMSS signatures at all on deposits/preregs. 
2. We verify them on the EL. 
3. We verify them on the CL. 

You went with 3, my preferred version would be 1 if possible. And <@774033563732541451> profiled this with 2 in mind if I understood correctly. So we are all over the place 😅

author: jtraglia

content: Right now, I would prefer option 2.

author: jtraglia

author: potuz

author: potuz
content: so I am on 1 > 2 > 3

author: jtraglia
content: Yep. So if we can design everything in such a way that signatures are not required, because there are no attack vectors, I would be fine with having no signatures.

author: jtraglia
content: But right now, it feels like having no signatures (proof of possession) is just making everything else more difficult.

author: potuz
content: I agree with this, it seems that forcing the proof of possession solves a bunch of problems and even problems that we do not know about yet

author: jsign
content:
Following up on the above: I opened https://github.com/ethereum/pq-staking-contracts/pull/9, which moves the contracts to EIP-8483 and has them verify a leanXMSS proof of possession on every registration. The signature goes in calldata and is never stored or sent to the CL.

The PR description has a good summary (if you're only interested in numbers, see [rendered readme](https://github.com/jsign/pq-staking-contracts/blob/6ac26eafc0b5f6e43b16300c95d88e99cc3ab691/contracts/README.md#gas-of-the-proof-of-possession)), and I left some comments on the diff. No review is needed, I just made the comments in case anyone wants to look at some details.

I still don't have merge permissions (in flux), so I'll have to wait for Kev. He is "OOO" although you know how this works... he is still working, but trying not to ping him until next week 😅 

I think the idea of merging this soon is to have a clear place to understand the PoP validation costs/tradeoffs. Feel free to share the PR to others for any further discussion. (Or wait until is merged if you want to create further PRs with more optimizations before sharing more broadly if cost can be smaller).
